calls.video_title: Should Investors Buy Costco Stock Instead of Walmart Stock? | COST Stock Analysis WMT Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: Comparative pick over WMT — Costco more fairly valued; inventory turnover 15.1 vs Walmart 12, expansion runway (less than 1/10th Walmart's store count yet nearly half the revenue).
calls.base_case: DCF $843 vs market $900; consistent with his prior COST BUY — no flip.
calls.bull_case: Store expansion + e-commerce growth (nearly 2x overall revenue growth) reignites the premium multiple.
calls.bear_case: Forward P/E 36.3 is still rich for a 3.8% margin retailer; any comp-sales miss de-rates it.

calls.price_at_call: DCF fair value $843 vs ~$897 market (only 6% overvalued; fwd P/E 36)
calls.thesis: First BUY since ~2021/22 — stock down ~20% from highs is a rare fairly-valued entry; would do half before and half after Sep 24 earnings.
calls.base_case: DCF $843 vs market $897 — within margin of safety; 9% US comp sales (Aug), 17.9% digital growth, 90%+ membership renewal, 22.6% ROIC.
calls.bull_case: Earnings beat reignites the premium multiple; compounding at near-historic low relative valuation.
calls.bear_case: Valuation still 36x forward; a soft quarter on Sep 24 extends the de-rating despite quality.
